(()=>{const out={};const tr=PT8.RING_IDX;for(const id of ['merc']){PT8.launch({mode:'mp',rally:true,circuit:true,track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:id,alt:0}],ai:[]});const c=RACE.cars[0];c.forceAI=1;c.ai={skill:1,lat:0,name:'T'};let ex=0,rs=0,pe=false,pr=false,mx=0,t=0,ts=performance.now(),resAt=[];for(let i=0;i<60*900;i++){step(1/60);if(RACE.state==='count'&&i>60*20)RACE.state='race';if(RACE.state==='done'||(c.lapT||[]).length>=1)break;const e=c.exp>0;if(e&&!pe){ex++;const T=RACE.T,k=((c.unw%T.N)+T.N)%T.N;out['x'+ex]={m:Math.round(k*T.sp),kmh:Math.round(c.sp*3.6),hist:(window.__h||[]).slice(-6)}}{const T=RACE.T,k=((c.unw%T.N)+T.N)%T.N,la=(c.x-T.x[k])*Math.cos(T.psi[k])-(c.z-T.z[k])*Math.sin(T.psi[k]);(window.__h=window.__h||[]).push([Math.round(k*T.sp),Math.round(c.sp*3.6),+la.toFixed(1)]);if(window.__h.length>400)window.__h.splice(0,200)}pe=e;const r=c.respT>.5;if(r&&!pr){rs++;resAt.push(Math.round(((c.unw%RACE.T.N)+RACE.T.N)%RACE.T.N*RACE.T.sp))}pr=r;mx=Math.max(mx,c.sp);t=i/60}out[id]={lap:(c.lapT||[]).map(x=>+x.toFixed(1)),ex,rs,resAt:resAt.slice(0,12),kmh:Math.round(mx*3.6),t:+t.toFixed(0),st:RACE.state,unw:c.unw,ms:Math.round(performance.now()-ts)};PT8.cleanupRace&&PT8.cleanupRace()}return JSON.stringify(out)})()
